Hasty Hearth is a passive guild perk that permanently reduces the hearthstone cooldown for all guild members by 15 minutes, making the cooldown equal to 15 minutes. It also affects Astral Recall and The Innkeeper's Daughter, as well as the various Hearthstone toys obtainable from special events.

The Hatescale Burrow is a decently-large cave system found off the Spring Road on the Veiled Stair. It is infested by Hatescale Ironfaces and Hatescale Spitters, led by Leechfingers.

.]] Hatred's Vice was the territory of the Palewind tribe of yaungol. The Sha of Hatred came through, causing tribe members to turn against one another with the end result that the entire village was slaughtered. Ashfang Hyenas have come to scavenge the pieces. Several yaungol oil derricks are here. Hatred's Vice can be found along the great wall bordering Kun-Lai Summit, in between Longying Outpost and the Gao-Ran Battlefront. Off to the west are the Upper Sumprushes and the Dampsoil Burrow and immediately to the south is Shallowstep Pass. The totem Trapped in a Strange Land can be found in the middle of camp near where members of the Shado-Pan Caravan set up for a few quests.

The Hatescale tribe of saurok live in the Veiled Stair waiting for the opportunity to reclaim the land back from the pandaren. Until that day comes, they keep busy by stealing from travelers along the Spring Road.
Hatchlings are hatched from Young Egg of Ji-Kun on the lower platforms and soon after eating yellow puddles of food that land on them they grow into Fledglings.

troll headhunters.]] Headhunters are spearmen specialized in tracking and hunting their opponents. Many headhunters are trolls, dexterous spearthrowers and experts at taking trophies on their fallen opponents. Through a combination of learning how to channel their rage and alchemical means, troll headhunters can become known as berserkers.

Hazu'Asnab was a nerubian spiderlord. He gave a human female who had taken several artifacts from the Scourge a spidersilk scroll that promised her safe conduct through nerubian lands and excellent compensation for the artifacts. The woman died and her corpse was found and looted by a goblin. Brann Bronzebeard bought the artifacts in Gadgetzan and took the letter, both to finish her task and allow him a chance to interact with the nerubians. The words on the scroll according to Brann were "I bear tokens against the Scourge! Hazu'Asnab commands that you permit me safe passage! I carry his seal!" Brann then said he traded the artifacts for six days and nights among them in the Sundered Monolit

Havenshire is located north of New Avalon, and southeast of Death's Breach and Acherus: The Ebon Hold. Havenshire comprises the Havenshire Mine, Light's Point Tower, Light's Point along the beach, the Havenshire Stables, the Havenshire Farms, the Crypt of Remembrance, and the Havenshire Lumber Mill.

The Havenshire Farms are located in south-central Havenshire, south of the Havenshire Stables, southeast of the Havenshire Lumber Mill and north of the Crypt of Remembrance. In the Ruins of the Scarlet Enclave, a plague cauldron takes up the space in the center of the former pumpkin patch. The pumpkins themselves have also been transformed into plagued flora.

The Havenshire Lumber Mill is located in west Havenshire, just to the south of Death's Breach and Acherus: The Ebon Hold, southwest of the Havenshire Stables and northwest of the Havenshire Farms. After the destruction of the Scarlet Enclave, the lumber mill is unoccupied.

Havenshire Mine is located in northern Havenshire, just to the east of Death's Breach and to the west of Light's Point Tower, and north of the Havenshire Stables. After the destruction of the Scarlet Enclave the mine is abandoned.

Havenshire Colts are horses found at the Havenshire Stables in Havenshire. They are a part of a Death Knight quest Grand Theft Palomino, in which a Death Knight has to steal a Havenshire Colt, which will later become their Deathcharger mount in the follow-up quest.

Havenshire Stallions are a kind of horse found at the Havenshire Stables in Havenshire. They are a part of a Death Knight quest Grand Theft Palomino, in which a Death Knight has to steal a Havenshire Stallion, which will later become their Deathcharger mount in the follow-up quest.

Havenshire Mares are a horse found at the Havenshire Stables in Havenshire. They are a part of a Death Knight quest Grand Theft Palomino, in which a Death Knight has to steal a Havenshire Mare, which will later become their Deathcharger mount in the follow-up quest.

The Headguard of Westrift can be looted from the Cache of Eregos after defeating Ley-Guardian Eregos in the Oculus on normal mode.

Completion of Killing Two Scourge With One Skeleton results in Crusader Olakin being abducted by a Frostwyrm (Ghostwing). Now, it's time to bring him back. This quest introduces a new Phase in Fleshwerks. The area is teeming with Corpulent Horrors and geists, who are in turn being attacked by Crusaders afoot and Ebon Knights on horseback.
Hauberk of the Arcane Wraith drops from Anomalus in the Nexus on heroic mode.

The Head of the Horseman frequently attacks you when you battle the Headless Horseman. The disemobdied head is thrown and is formed when the Horseman on the mount is brought to low health. After you've greatly damaged the head, it will re-attach to the body.

Have Keg, Will Travel is related to the seasonal event Brewfest. Completing this achievement is also an objective of the meta achievement Brewmaster (achievement). Note that you will complete this achievement no matter which mount is obtained, and you only need one.
Haunted Herring is created with Northrend Cooking (1); taught by Recipe: Haunted Herring, a world drop.
He Knows If You've Been Naughty is related to the seasonal world event, the Feast of Winter Veil. Completing this achievement is criteria for the meta achievement Merrymaker.
The Head of Cyanigosa dropped from Cyanigosa in the Violet Hold on heroic mode.
Hauberk of Totemic Mastery drops from Drakkari Colossus in Gundrak on normal mode.
Head of Gammothra drops from Gammothra the Tormentor in the Borean Tundra.
He Feeds On Your Tears is an achievement for defeating Algalon on the first try without any deaths.
He's Not Getting Any Older (10 player) was a dungeon & raids achievement earned for defeating Yogg-Saron within 7 minutes on 10-player mode.
Hazzali Sandreavers are silithid reavers found in the Gaping Chasm in Tanaris.
__NOTOC__ Hazzali Stingers are silithid wasps found in the Gaping Chasm in Tanaris.
__NOTOC__ Hazzali Swarmers are silithid scarabs found in the Gaping Chasm in Tanaris. They are usually accompanied by a Silithid Swarm.
Hazzali Tunnelers are silithid scarabs found in the Gaping Chasm in Tanaris.
__NOTOC__ Hazzali Workers are silithid workers found in the Gaping Chasm in Tanaris.
Hazzali Parasites are silithid scarabs found in the Gaping Chasm in Tanaris. The parasites come out after killing a Hazzali Stinger or Hazzali Swarmer.
Hazewood Bushes can be found north of Granite Springs in Grizzly Hills.

Havoc the Heartless was an especially cruel orc bandit, known for killing men, women, and children alike. He at one point let a blood elf from his groupd purchased a sword from the famous blacksmith, Nori Blackfinger, which set in motion a chain of events that culminated in the death of Nori's son, Eli, and eventually to Havoc's death at Nori's hands.

Haunting Spirits are found around a player afflicted with the Haunting Spirits debuff. The debuff is cast by Haunted Servitors in Shadowfang Keep and lasts for five minutes. During the five minutes the player is haunted (cursed), Haunting Spirits will spawn periodically around the player and trigger combat.
Have Group, Will Travel was a guild perk granted at guild level 21 that summoned everyone in the raid or party to the summoner's location.
Headdress of the First Shaman is a rare archaeology artifact that requires 300 skill to find and 130 Orc Archaeology Fragments to solve. Up to three keystones may be used to complete it.
The Headcover of the Speaker is a quest reward from Slaves of the Firelord (Horde).
Haze Leaves are found in Hazewood Bushes north of the Granite Springs in Grizzly Hills.
__NOTOC__ The Headguard of the Sunwalker is a quest reward from Weapons of Darkness (tauren).
__NOTOC__ Haunted War Drum is a rare archaeology artifact that requires 100 Troll Archaeology Fragments to solve. Up to three Troll Tablet keystones may be used to complete it.

Have... Have We Met? is a quest achievement earned for waving at the NPCs in Sethria's Roost. Requirement for the meta-achievement Veteran of the Molten Front. A very large number of NPCs can possibly join players on the quest The Protectors of Hyjal, part of the Firelands Invasion daily quests. The NPCs do not have to be attached to the player in order for the /wave to count.
